def transform(grid):
    g = tuple(map(tuple, grid))
    objs = list(objects(g, T, F, T))
    ca = max(objs, key=len)   # source shape
    cb = min(objs, key=len)   # marker
    col = color(ca)
    ia, ja = toindices(ca); ib, jb = toindices(cb)
    col_overlap = bool({j for _, j in ja} & {j for _, j in jb})
    if col_overlap:
        # vertical: mirror across bottom edge, place below
        patch = hmirror(toindices(ca))
        dr = lowermost(ia) + 1 - uppermost(ia)
        mir = shift(recolor(col, patch), (dr, 0))
    else:
        # horizontal toward marker
        if leftmost(jb) > rightmost(ja):   # marker to the right
            patch = vmirror(toindices(ca))
            dc = rightmost(ja) + 1 - leftmost(ja)
        else:                               # marker to the left
            patch = vmirror(toindices(ca))
            dc = leftmost(ja) - 1 - rightmost(ja)
        mir = shift(recolor(col, patch), (0, dc))
    out = cover(g, cb)
    return [list(r) for r in paint(out, mir)]

def T(in_, out): return transform(in_) == out
